title: Rising to the Occasion: Lender’s Bagels and the Frozen Food Revolution
lineage: Notes paraphrase selected source passages; not a source copy.

passages.note: The authors distinguish Springfield retail introduction in 1930, retailer credit in 1931, and a lower-cost rented display case introduced in 1934. They describe 26 frozen items and expensive original cases. This retrospective business history does not establish that every 1930 shop leased a case.
